1) Try portal upload again at https://console.redwoodinference.com/procure/portal/Pinebrook (include vendor id PIN-98421 in the PO).
2) If portal upload fails, Pinebrook should email procurement@redwoodinference.com with the attached Excel plus a screenshot; we will do a manual intake and create a PO record on their behalf.
3) Once SOW amendment is agreed, Legal will route DocuSign. Use HubSpot activity HS-42219 to track.

I’ve attached a short PO guidance doc for external teams (PO_Instructions.pdf) — please share with Elena. I’ll run the credit check and follow up by EOD; if the check is green I’ll stamp Net 45 and the 5% incremental discount.
